rows.grounds: epithet or name referring to the sacred basil plant; nominative form in a series of divine names
compound epithet: tulasī (holy basil) + varyā (excellent, best); denotes preeminence associated with tulasī
compound epithet: tulā (balance, scale) + jā (born); denotes origin or arising from balance
compound epithet: tulajā (balance-born) + īśvarī (sovereign lady, mistress); denotes rulership over or identity as the balance-born
